name: pysms_contains_cliques_clique_size4_num_cliques1_vertices14__v7
prompt:
Generate a graph with 14 vertices that consists of exactly 1 vertex-disjoint clique(s), each of size 4. Every vertex must belong to one of these cliques, and the only edges in the graph are those within these cliques.

Return the graph as a list of edges (u, v) with 0 <= u < v < 14, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no graph exists.
